# Peptide Chooser

> An independent US comparison site: peptide products next to FDA-approved alternatives, with evidence, FDA status and price per month for each goal. We compare; we never sell.

- [Best peptides by goal, compared | Peptide Chooser](https://peptidechooser.com/): FDA status, real prices and evidence for each goal, checked and dated. Peptide products next to the approved alternatives, from an independent site that never sells.
- [About Peptide Chooser](https://peptidechooser.com/about/): Peptide Chooser is an independent site that compares peptide products and sellers for people in the United States.
- [How we rate peptide products and sellers | Peptide Chooser](https://peptidechooser.com/how-we-rate/): The five criteria Peptide Chooser uses to rate every peptide product and seller: evidence, FDA status, lab testing, real price and transparency.
- [Contact | Peptide Chooser](https://peptidechooser.com/contact/): Contact Peptide Chooser by email for corrections, listings, press and partnerships.
- [Affiliate and medical disclosure | Peptide Chooser](https://peptidechooser.com/disclosure/): How Peptide Chooser earns money through paid links, and why nothing on the site is medical advice.
- [Privacy policy | Peptide Chooser](https://peptidechooser.com/privacy/): What information Peptide Chooser collects, how it is used and how to contact us about your data.
